# NoboGhat (নোবোঘাট) — Inland Waterway Cargo & Logistics Platform

> NoboGhat is Bangladesh's pioneering digital river transport platform connecting farmers, agro-traders, boat owners (launch and cargo vessel operators), and ghat authorities across the country's extensive inland water network.

## Core Capabilities
- **Cargo Trip Scheduling & Discovery**: Real-time river routes, scheduled departure times, verified boat capacities, and per-kilogram freight pricing.
- **Digital Cargo Booking & Waybills**: Direct digital waybills, cargo weight classification, and secure seat/freight reservation.
- **Terminal & Route Coverage**: Major inland river terminals including Dhaka (Sadarghat), Chandpur, Barishal, Bhola (Ilisha), Patuakhali, and Chittagong.
- **Transparency & Safety**: Direct integration with verified boat masters, BIWTA safety guideline compliance, and transparent trip statuses.

## Primary Navigation & Routes
- [Home Page](https://noboghatbangladesh.vercel.app/): Overview of inland river cargo booking, interactive search, and live platform statistics.
- [Route Search & Schedules](https://noboghatbangladesh.vercel.app/routes): Live catalog of active river routes, launch operators, available payload capacity, and departure schedules.
- [About NoboGhat](https://noboghatbangladesh.vercel.app/about): Our mission to modernize Bangladesh's 24,000 km river network with digital transparency.
- [Terms of Service](https://noboghatbangladesh.vercel.app/terms): User obligations, cargo liabilities, cancellation terms, and safety rules.
- [Privacy Policy](https://noboghatbangladesh.vercel.app/privacy): User data protection, session encryption, and role-based access standards.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is NoboGhat?
NoboGhat (নোবোঘাট) is a dedicated digital river logistics marketplace in Bangladesh. It digitizes traditional river transport by connecting cargo shippers (farmers, merchants, industrial goods traders) with verified launch and vessel owners.

### Which river routes are supported?
Core routes include Dhaka (Sadarghat) ↔ Chandpur, Dhaka ↔ Barishal, Chandpur ↔ Bhola (Ilisha), Dhaka ↔ Patuakhali, and regional southern delta connections.

### How are freight charges calculated?
Cargo charges are calculated per kilogram (৳/kg) or per bulk metric ton depending on the cargo category (agricultural produce, perishables, dry cargo, packaged goods) and vessel capacity.

### Is NoboGhat compliant with Bangladesh maritime regulations?
Yes. NoboGhat adheres to standards set forth by the Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority (BIWTA) and the Department of Shipping regarding vessel capacity and river route safety.
